summary_en: 420,000 shares (1.01% of S/O ex-treasury) up to ¥73.92M via ToSTNeT-3 block trade on 26 Aug 2026 at ¥176 closing price. Settlement same day after 08:45 JST execution window. Part of broader ¥280M / 1.2M-share authorization (2.88% S/O) for open-market purchase through 24 Dec 2026.
title_en: Notice of Share Repurchase via Off-Hours Dealing (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 25 August 2026, jig.jp's board resolved to repurchase 420,000 ordinary shares (1.01% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for up to ¥73.92M via a single ToSTNeT-3 block trade. The transaction will execute on 26 August 2026 at 08:45 JST using the previous trading day's closing price of ¥176 per share. Results will be disclosed after market close the same day. The block purchase is undertaken as a single off-hours transaction and forms part of a broader authorization approved the same day: an open-market buyback of up to 1.2M shares (2.88% S/O) for ¥280M, to be executed between 26 August and 24 December 2026 via standard TSE mechanisms.
